name: tuning-revert
note: CR-16's last two rows on a state's session fixture (wj-ia-300) at 1280x720: tuning.open reveals the panel over the folded right dock; a preset and a theme.tune make a live change, and the panel says Esc reverts it; the real Escape key (transient.close) reverts both to the tuning at the open, the tint palette included; tuning.selector.revert with nothing pending is refused, naming why; a new knob change is exported as tuning-diff.txt into the run folder, the panel saying so, and Escape reverts it too. After every step the head's state digest and the tint bytes are as they were.
